entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: Metathran commander created by Urza, twin of Agnate.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Thaddeus's twin and fellow Metathran commander.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Creator of the Metathran commanders in the Bloodline project.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian who captured and experimented on Thaddeus.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Replaced Thaddeus as commander of half the Metathran army.

entities.name: Curtains of Time
entities.description: Time bubbles on Tolaria where time passed extremely slowly.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Site of the Battle of Koilos.

events.summary: Agnate and Thaddeus are placed in the Curtains of Time on Tolaria after their training.
events.quote: Agnate and Thaddeus were placed in the Curtains of Time

events.summary: Urza and Barrin release the commanders; Agnate collapses and Thaddeus revives him with CPR.
events.quote: Thaddeus used CPR to revive him

events.summary: Each leads part of the army in a pincer attack on Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians at Koilos; Tsabo intercepts Thaddeus's bond and lures him into a trap.
events.quote: Agnate and Thaddeus each led part of the army in a pincer attack against Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians

events.summary: Thaddeus is captured and experimented upon by Tsabo Tavoc, confirming the Metathran and Phyrexians are alike.
events.quote: the Metathran and Phyrexians were more alike than different

events.summary: Agnate finds Thaddeus reduced to ribcage and head and, at his wish, ends his suffering.
events.quote: Agnate then fulfilled Thaddeus' last wish, delivering a coup-de-grace to him to end his suffering.

events.summary: Eladamri replaces Thaddeus as commander during the Battle of Koilos.
events.quote: Thaddeus was replaced by Eladamri as the commander of the other half of the Metathran army

relations.quote: created by Urza as part of his Bloodline project
